testcase.name: Scenario: Retain independent panel visibility across ribbon tabs: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/panel-visibility-snapshot/checkout/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:141:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain independent panel visibility across ribbon tabs ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the 3D Model ribbon is docked on the left with Modify visible ✔ And Navigate is visible on the View ribbon ✔ When the user hides Modify through the direct panel selector ✔ Then the Modify panel disappears from the 3D Model ribbon ✔ When the user switches to the View ribbon ✔ Then Navigate remains visible ✔ When the user returns to the 3D Model ribbon ✔ And the user opens the direct panel selector ✔ Then Modify is unchecked ✔ When the user selects Modify in the panel selector ✔ Then the Modify panel returns to the 3D Model ribbon ✔ And the panel selector remains open with Modify checked
